name: EMSA-SG 歐洲前瞻自然史世代
group: Wenning、Geser 等（歐洲 MSA 研究小組 EMSA-SG）
findings: MSA 病程快：UMSARS-II 一年約惡化 UMSARS-II ≈+57%、UMSARS-I ≈+36%（相對基線；Geser 2006）。獨立預測較快進展者＝發病時間短、對左旋多巴無反應；基線帕金森症與神經性膀胱障礙預示較差存活。第二年進展略趨緩。
significance: → MSA 進展遠快於 SCA，是設計 MSA 試驗（樣本數、追蹤期、端點靈敏度）的核心對照；也凸顯若做 MSA 細胞治療，療效窗口與收案時機的重要性。

en.group: Wenning, Geser et al. (European MSA Study Group, EMSA-SG)
en.findings: MSA progresses fast: over one year UMSARS-II worsens ~+57% and UMSARS-I ~+36% vs baseline (Geser 2006). Independent predictors of faster progression: short symptom duration and absent levodopa response; baseline parkinsonism and neurogenic bladder predict poorer survival. Progression slows somewhat in year 2.
en.significance: MSA progresses far faster than SCA — the core comparator for MSA trial design (sample size, follow-up, endpoint sensitivity), and underscores treatment-window/enrollment timing for any MSA cell therapy.
en.name: EMSA-SG European prospective natural-history cohort

name: NAMSA 北美前瞻世代
group: Low、Singer 等（北美 MSA 研究聯盟）
findings: 北美最大 MSA 前瞻世代。收案多屬較晚期，自基線起中位存活約 1.8 年；確立 UMSARS 進展與自律神經、跌倒等預後因子。
significance: → 北美對照基準；晚期收案的快速惡化，提醒 MSA 介入宜在較早期進行。

en.group: Low, Singer et al. (North American MSA consortium)
en.findings: The largest North American prospective MSA cohort; enrollment skewed to later disease, median survival ~1.8 years from baseline; characterized UMSARS progression and autonomic/falls prognostic factors.
en.significance: North American comparator baseline; rapid decline in late-stage enrollment argues for earlier MSA intervention.
en.name: NAMSA North American prospective cohort

name: MSA 存活與病程總覽
taiwan: 台灣本土 MSA 大型自然史/存活世代資料公開來源有限（需查證）。
findings: MSA 自症狀發作起中位存活約 6–10 年（範圍差異大）。亞型：西方以 MSA-P 較多、亞洲（含日本）以 MSA-C 較多。近年以疾病進展模型（Kühnel 2022）預測個體軌跡與試驗豐富化。
significance: → 亞洲 MSA-C 比例較高，與仲恩 MSC 的小腦保護敘事潛在契合；但存活短、病程快，是 MSA 商業與試驗設計的關鍵限制。

en.findings: Median survival from symptom onset ~6–10 years (wide range). Subtypes: MSA-P predominates in the West, MSA-C in Asia (incl. Japan). Recent progression-modeling (Kühnel 2022) predicts individual trajectories and enriches trials.
en.significance: Asia's higher MSA-C share potentially fits Steminent's MSC cerebellar-protection narrative; but short survival and fast course are key constraints for MSA commercialization and trial design.
en.taiwan: Large Taiwan-native MSA natural-history/survival cohort data limited in public sources (to verify).
en.name: MSA survival and disease course overview
